capabilities: Save rendered Mermaid diagrams as PNG files
Copy diagram images to the system clipboard
Apply a fixed light or dark export palette
Show hover buttons on diagrams in Live Preview, Reading mode and popout windows
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid source-code exporter; it saves the rendered diagram as a PNG image.
extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux), Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. Pre-release builds can be installed through BRAT. The plugin makes no network requests and never reads or writes paths directly; saving goes through the browser download path.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams but gives no way to save one as an image file or put it on the clipboard.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from Community Plugins

summary: Adds hover buttons to rendered Mermaid diagrams that save them as high-DPI PNG files or copy them to the clipboard.
